name: Wax-up smile mock-up

lead: A wax-up or mock-up previews planned cosmetic tooth changes so patient and dentist can judge size, shape and proportion before treatment.
Only a short encyclopedic description and one registered digital smile design trial were found.

paras: A model or temporary is shaped to the planned result and tried against the lips and smile line, sometimes also testing speech and bite.
The preview itself is non-permanent; the sources describe no specific risks of the mock-up.

trials.title: AI-Assisted vs. Conventional Digital Smile Design for Laminate Veneers: A Prospective Crossover Study

lead: A wax-up or mock-up is a diagnostic preview in cosmetic dentistry: dentists build a model of planned tooth changes to guide preparation before veneers are made [1]. It shows how changes in tooth size, shape and proportion will relate to the gums, lips and smile line, and temporaries based on it can test appearance, speech and bite before final work [1].

Digital smile design is a related, software-based approach. One registered crossover study of 44 participants compares AI-assisted with conventional digital smile design for laminate veneers; it is active and not yet reporting results [2].

paras: A registered prospective crossover study (NCT07863895) is comparing AI-assisted with conventional digital smile design for laminate veneers in 44 participants; no results were available when listed [2]. No other studies found for traditional wax-up mock-ups in the sources reviewed.
